WITH
  cohort_2007 AS (
    SELECT CustomerKey
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
    HAVING toYear(MIN(DateKey)) = 2007
  ),
  buyers_2008 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CustomerKey
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2008
  ),
  buyers_2009 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CustomerKey
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
  ),
  retained_2008 AS (
    SELECT CustomerKey FROM cohort_2007 WHERE CustomerKey IN (SELECT CustomerKey FROM buyers_2008)
  )
SELECT
  (SELECT count() FROM cohort_2007) AS cohort_2007_customers,
  (SELECT count() FROM retained_2008) AS retained_in_2008,
  (SELECT count() FROM retained_2008 WHERE CustomerKey IN (SELECT CustomerKey FROM buyers_2009)) AS retained_in_2009
